plan.title: bug(design-critique): the panel-deposit guards are inconsistent prose, and panel completeness has no executable consumer

narratives.Description: Reconcile the seven bind-guard loci in content/contracts/design-critique.md onto the deposit-independent sibling-completeness phrasing that already exists, and state plainly that panel completeness is behavioural.
narratives.Origin: Ingested from https://github.com/deftai/directive/issues/3850 (body recut 2026-08-28 to the bound contract; synthesis comment 5454966234, successor lean 5454472108)
narratives.Overview:
Issue #3850 was recut on 2026-08-28 after a three-critic refutation panel. The original filing's diagnosis and all three of its remedies were refuted; one was actively dangerous.

Two separate defects, which the filing conflated.

1. Seven contract loci disagree about the same guard. `panel-deposit` appears as a bind-guard qualifier at `:177`, `:192`, `:224`, `:246`, `:248`, `:260`, `:320`. Five condition sibling completeness on siblings "named on the panel-deposit". Two already use deposit-independent phrasing: `:320`'s closing clause ("or while same-round siblings remain unposted") and router skill line 44 ("not while same-round siblings outstanding"). Converge the seven on the wording that already exists; do not invent new wording.

2. Panel completeness has no executable consumer. `evaluateCompletedArcRecord` reads the deposit only as an in-flight marker; `SIBLINGS_FIELD_RE` is consumed solely as one term of `isPanelDepositBody`'s shape test. It never counts critic posts and never compares them against an expected N. `evaluateParentAudit` carries no round, sibling, or deposit field and has zero non-test call sites. The contract's phrasing implies a gate that does not exist.

The operator decided prose-only on 2026-08-28 (human-origin). The contract should describe reality rather than gain a new machine gate.

Out of bounds, each measured rather than guessed:

- Do NOT key any gate on panel-deposit contents. The repository is public, comments are world-writable, and `isPanelDepositBody` accepts a bare `panel-deposit` token with zero fields as well-formed. One `siblings: 99` comment would permanently block auto-bind on every open arc.
- Do NOT implement absence-as-unsatisfied. `:107` requires a deposit only for two or more critics and N=1 is the default spend; this would block every N=1 arc.
- Do NOT change the router skill `content/skills/deft-directive-design-critique/SKILL.md`. Line 44 already says the right thing, and that file is generated from `content/packs/skills/skills-pack-0.1.json`.
- Do NOT touch `packages/core/src/design-critique/completed-arc-record.ts`. No code change is in scope.
- Do NOT add a new predicate or a regression test for panel completeness. There is no predicate to pin and the operator decided not to create one.

Refs #3824, #3848, #3851.
